tool_routing: Permission-based architecture: strict read-only by default, explicit approval for modifications
Bash tool sandboxing: filesystem+network isolation, configurable with /sandbox command
Write access restricted to project folder and subfolders — cannot modify parent dirs without permission
Tool routing via MCP (Model Context Protocol): open standard for connecting AI tools to external data sources
SDK-based custom tools: Agent SDK lets you build agents with Claude Code's tools and capabilities
memory_system: CLAUDE.md: project-level Markdown file read at every session start (coding standards, architecture decisions)
Auto memory: Claude automatically saves learnings like build commands and debugging insights across sessions
Session context is conversation-based: subagents have separate context windows
Persistent memory directory for subagents: ~/.claude/agent-memory/ for cross-conversation learnings
session_mgmt: Multiple surfaces sharing same engine: Terminal, VS Code, Desktop, Web, JetBrains — same CLAUDE.md, settings, MCP
Session persistence: /resume to continue previous conversations
Remote Control: continue local sessions from mobile or browser
Background agents: run multiple independent sessions in parallel
context_mgmt: Subagent architecture: each subagent runs in independent context window with custom system prompt
Built-in subagents: Explore (read-only, Haiku), Plan (read-only), General-purpose (full access)
Context isolation by design: subagents keep exploration results out of main conversation
Custom subagents with YAML frontmatter Markdown files: system prompt, tool restrictions, model selection
security_model: Sandboxed bash tool: filesystem and network isolation
Network command approval: curl/wget not auto-approved by default
Prompt fatigue mitigation: allowlisting common safe commands
Isolated VM for cloud execution, credential proxy, audit logging
Fail-closed matching: unmatched commands require manual approval
CLI_UX: Modes: interactive TUI, one-shot, JSON streaming, Yolo (auto-approve), Zen (background)
Rich CLI: plan/act toggle, MCP support, checkpoints with /undo, sub-agent spawning
mcp_protocol: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a core extension point for Claude Code
Connect to Google Drive, Jira, Slack, databases, APIs via MCP servers
MCP servers configured in project source code as part of Claude Code settings
Accept Edits mode: auto-approves file edits and filesystem bash commands
execution_model: Agent teams: coordinator delegates to specialist agents with separate tools and context
Scheduled tasks: cron-like recurring automations (PR summaries, dependency checks)
Agent SDK for fully custom orchestration with control over tool access and permissions
Background agents: run full sessions in parallel from task board
Kanban: web-based multi-agent task board with worktrees, auto-commit, dependency chains
